title: English Conversation 24:  Taking Sides
content: 1. I can't understand why...: a sentence pattern used when angry or surprised at something or someone - I can't understand why you like this TV show. It is so boring. - I can't understand why we have to wear suits to work. We don't meet customers, so it is not necessary. 2. to be rude: to behave in an inappropriate way; to not be polite - He is rude. - It is rude to stand very close to people in my country. 3. to be mean: to be not nice - She always yells at everyone. She is mean. - He called me fat. He is so mean.
